visuals.heading: Seat Math Behind the Big Exams

items.text: A filter is different from a door.
Career options after 12th are best chosen by lane, not by stream label.
The most useful first question is not "which course".
Do not choose the most famous course by default.
Count the cost of one more attempt: a year of income, fees, and stress.

blocks.heading: Three Proofs: the High-Income Skill Portfolio

items.text: Whichever lane you choose, a high-income skill portfolio is what raises your income ceiling and brings earlier financial freedom.
The one deep skill that a lane is really paying for: coding, analysis, design, clinical practice, writing, sales, or a trade.
What raises your value beside it: data with commerce, communication with science, AI use with design, Excel with any office job.

15,38,468 Unique Candidates Appeared in Main; 18,826 IIT Seats
About 20,00,000 appeared; 11,21,000 qualified; 1,36,939 MBBS seats on the NMC matrix of 22 July 2026, of which 63,296 are government seats
20,00,000 ÷ 1,36,939 = 14.6 test-takers per seat. 11,21,000 ÷ 63,296 = 17.7 qualified candidates per government seat.
JEE Advanced to an IIT seat
JEE Main rank alone (NITs, IIITs, other government-funded institutes)
48,372 of the 67,323 JoSAA seats (25,162 NIT, 11,518 IIIT, 11,692 other institutes) need only a Main rank
48,372 ÷ 67,323 = 71.9% of JoSAA seats. 15,38,468 ÷ 48,372 = 31.8 Main test-takers per seat.
Qualifying is not the same as getting a seat. Price a private MBBS seat, or an allied-health and BSc plan, before results.
JEE Main to an IIT seat
A good Main score is not an IIT plan. It is an NIT, IIIT, or state-college plan unless Advanced also goes well.
JEE Advanced to an IIT seat
Even after qualifying, about two in three qualifiers do not get an IIT seat, so rank, branch, and college are traded off in counselling.
JEE Main rank alone (NITs, IIITs, other government-funded institutes)
Most engineering seats on the central list never needed Advanced. State counselling adds more seats on top.
One in five clears the first level. Treat CA as a serious filter with a backup degree running beside it.
A quarter of those who register never sit the test. There is no single seat pool, so shortlist universities and course rules first.

CUET UG (central and many state and private universities)
Result came out on 23 June 2026. No single counselling: apply on each university portal, mostly in the weeks after results.
Pick domain subjects that match the degrees you want, and keep 3 to 5 universities as targets.

Registration opened on 2 June 2026 with 67,323 seats across 138 institutes (23 IITs, IISc Bengaluru, 31 NITs, IIEST Shibpur, 26 IIITs, 56 other government-funded institutes). Round 5 was running in July, with reporting into mid-August.
Rank by branch and college quality together, not by brand alone. Keep state options as backup.

NEET (UG) 2026 result came out on 16 July 2026. On the NMC matrix of 22 July 2026, MBBS seats stood at 1,36,939 (63,296 government, 73,643 private). A September 2026 revision reports 1,40,664 (64,121 government, 76,543 private).
Compare government seats, state quota, and total private fees; keep allied health and BSc as live backups.
CLAT 2027: registration 3 August to 31 October 2026, exam on 6 December 2026. Class 12 needs 45% (40% for SC and ST).
If law interests you, register before the closing date. Dates change each year, so confirm on the official consortium site.

Registration for the January 2027 attempt closed on 1 September 2026. ICAI asks for a study period of about four months between registration and the exam. Passing needs 40% in each paper and 50% in aggregate.
You can register once you have passed or are appearing in Class 12, and provisionally after Class 10. Confirm the next cycle on the ICAI portal.
NDA 2 of 2026: 394 vacancies (370 men, 24 women). Army wing accepts any stream; Navy and Air Force need PCM.
Age window and dates reset each year. Watch the UPSC notice for the next cycle.
₹8 to ₹9 lakh for living security, tools, courses, and upskilling

blocks.heading: AI Pressure on Each Lane
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: AI pressure on each lane, and where to start

rows: Routine coding and report drafting are getting automated. The safer layer is problem framing, checking outputs, and shipping something real.
Build one project that uses AI to solve a real problem, and write down where you corrected it.
Basic data entry and administrative tasks are shrinking. Advisory, judgment, controls, and client trust remain human.
Learn Excel or Sheets deeply, then use AI for first drafts of analysis and always verify the numbers yourself.
AI helps with documentation and support, but licensing, accountability, and patient or client care stay with the professional.
Learn how digital tools support your field while you complete the formal degree.
The WEF Future of Jobs 2025 report now lists graphic designers among roles under pressure from generative AI. Generic output is the easiest to replace.
Build a portfolio with process notes and a clear niche. Taste and client understanding still matter.
Direct pressure is lower, since entry is exam-led. The risk is time cost, not automation.
Keep one earning skill alive beside preparation so an unsuccessful attempt does not leave you with nothing.
Hands-on trades are harder to automate, but digital tools are entering repair, maintenance, and inspection.
Add a digital layer: job logs, estimates, or basic automation of records.

visuals.heading: Do This Week

items.text: They list courses, not the daily work behind them.
They quote salaries with no stage, city, or median.
They never tell you what happens if the big exam does not work.
They ignore the family conversation, which decides more than any brochure.
Is it median or top.
How many students does it count.
Starting pay, year five, and senior pay are three different numbers.
Which employer type.
What did it cost to get there.
Ask what your child can finish and show, not only which college name sounds safe.
Read the placement median and the count of students it covers, not the headline package.
Set a loan-safety rule before you visit any college.
Keep one backup route open for every big-exam plan.
